question: In January 2022, who won the Rachael Heyhoe Flint Award for the ICC Women's Cricketer of the Year for 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Smriti Mandhana.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

 
• Rachael Heyhoe Flint Trophy for ICC Women’s Cricketer of the Year has been given to Smriti Mandhana (India).
 
• ICC Men’s T20I Cricketer of the Year has been awarded to Mohammad Rizwan (Pakistan).
